description: This file is a C++ source file implementing the RustAdapter plugin for the WPEFramework. It defines the class methods, handles plugin initialization, deinitialization, reference counting, and interaction with other components such as remote and local plugins, as well as utility functions for library path and authentication token retrieval.

classes.name: RustAdapter
classes.description: The main class implementing the RustAdapter plugin, managing plugin lifecycle, communication, and utility functions.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin based on configuration, choosing between local and remote plugin implementations.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and deletes the object if count reaches zero.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Handles JSON-RPC or callback invocation depending on build configuration.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes a communication channel (conditional on version).

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates a token and method (conditional on version).

methods.name: GetLibraryPathOrName
methods.description: Constructs the library path or name based on inputs.

methods.name: GetAuthToken
methods.description: Retrieves an authentication token for a given service and callsign.
